final_decision.report_summary: The initial comparison ranked n_geometry highest: 18/41 malignant TP and 12/124 benign alerts at confidence 0.40, with malignant all-GT correct-class IoU 0.3757. Original n had 13/41 TP, 11/124 benign alerts and IoU 0.2870 at confidence 0.50. The gain met the same rule at seed 3711. I recommend the seed 3710 n_geometry checkpoint at confidence 0.40 for further coursework development, while preserving the original n/s evaluation as the historical baseline. This is repeated improvement on the same validation images; it is not new independent test evidence.
